integrity: All graph masks, face relations, matching pairs, and directed cover relations are rebuilt from an explicit vertex-incidence rule; finite computation certifies precisely this finite case.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the fourteen-vertex Fano incidence graph at two-independence parameter only; no higher-order family, symmetry representation, or untested graph is classified. A separate external scientific audit has not been performed.
title: The Fano-incidence two-independence complex is a wedge of \(13\) five-spheres
